decisions.reason: The indoor air quality module is a current-generation sensor for the growing indoor climate market and costs little to keep in the modular catalog, so the option stays open.
The MQTT proxy costs almost nothing to host, but native MQTT bindings could make it redundant, so the risk of withdrawal is moderate while it still serves existing users.
Demand for CO2 monitoring rose sharply with indoor ventilation concerns, so the module's value has become clearer, and only a successor hardware generation would justify replacing it.
The touch panel accessory has low holding costs and still widens the user-interface options of the platform, so it is kept, though demand for niche accessories remains uncertain.
